Getting him back outside took hours ❤️

A kangaroo somehow ended up trapped inside a parking garage with no way to find his way back out. Dodo editor Brielle shares how rescuers from @VetsForCompassion spent hours carefully guiding him through the garage until they could finally get him safely back outside.

Hosted by Brielle
Produced by Ben
fulltitle: Kangaroo Gets Trapped In Parking Garage Until Rescuers Step In | The Dodo
